# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 charging stands for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

**Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand**
- WIRED's top pick. It charges the iPhone at 15W, fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer, and has a pad for AirPods in the base.
- The iPhone pad tilts, works in landscape for StandBy mode, and the stand has a 2-year warranty. The 36W power supply is included.
- Price: listed at $109, with WIRED showing $98, about $90 at Amazon and $80 at Best Buy.
- Where to buy: the links are in [WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/).

**Fastest: Nomad Stand One Max ($169)**
- Qi2 25W for the iPhone, fast Apple Watch charging, and a heavy base that lets you lift the phone off one-handed.
- No power adapter is included. You need a 40W one, and WIRED suggests Nomad's 40W Slim Adapter for $25.
- Details are in the [same WIRED guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/).

**Best 25W value: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 (Qi2.2 25W)**
- It has an active cooling fan, a 50W adapter in the box, and a button to turn the fan off at night. WIRED rates it as a fast travel-style charger.
- Price: $99.99 at ESR's US store, or about $82 with code PARTNER18, which the listing says it tested in ESR's cart on 2026-10-23.
- The 25W speed applies only to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. The iPhone Air, 16 and 16 Pro get 20W, and older models get 15W.
- Buy: [ESR CryoBoost via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand). This is an affiliate link, so the site earns a commission at no cost to you.

**Best on a budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station**
- WIRED calls it the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1 it has tested. It was $40 at Amazon (listed at $80), charges the iPhone at 15W, and includes a charger and cable.
- The Apple Watch charger is a separate piece that slots into the back, and the warranty is only 1 year.
- It's listed in the [WIRED guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/).

**Best for travel and desk: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable (Qi2 25W), $129.99**
- It folds flat and has the tallest, most adjustable stand of the foldables Macworld tested, with a 160° viewing angle. It comes with a 45W adapter and UK/EU plugs.
- Read [Macworld's review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html).
- For a cheaper foldable, WIRED likes the [Anker MagGo 3-in-1](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/), at about $80 on sale.

## My pick
- **Most people:** the Belkin, for its build quality and sale price.
- **iPhone 16 or 17 owners who want faster charging:** the ESR CryoBoost.
- **Overnight charging:** 25W makes little difference, so a 15W stand like the Belkin or ESR budget model is enough. WIRED makes the same point.

Check that your AirPods case supports wireless charging, since the base pad only works with those.

Prices come from the articles and may have changed, so confirm at checkout. The search results gave me direct buy links only for the ESR CryoBoost, so for the others I've linked to the guides that list the retailer links.
